units: Targ. Y. Ex. XXIII, 19 (cmp. Tanḥ. R’eh 17 s. v. גְּדִי).—Y. Ned. VII, 40ᶜ top (ref. to R. Meir’s opinion ib. VII, 2, v. preced.) דְגָנָהּ דארעא dry Egyptian beans are the bread of the land (Palestine, therefore implied in dagan); (ref. to the Rabbis’ opinion, ib.) דגנה מעבורה ‘its bread’ means its home growth.
